text: 创业板指跌超2%，沪指跌0.64%，深成指跌1.62%，AI应用、算力租赁、医药医疗、软件开发等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股近4200只。
text_en: The ChiNext Index fell over 2%, the Shanghai Composite fell 0.64%, and the Shenzhen Component fell 1.62%, with AI applications, computing power leasing, healthcare, and software development leading declines; nearly 4,200 stocks fell across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing.
